title: Save your reading desk
description: Resize the study column and keep a named arrangement with a shortcut.
steps: Open Notebook and Shelf.
Drag the column edge to resize the workspace.
Save Reading desk and assign a keyboard shortcut.

title: Keep passages in a Shelf folder
description: Collect two references and open their reading tabs together.
steps: Create a named Shelf folder.
Add John 1 and Psalm 119 by reference.
Open all of the folder’s passages, then close its tabs.

title: Arrange your toolbar
description: Add a reading control and drag existing buttons into a new order.
steps: Open Customize toolbar.
Find and add Text size.
Drag Shelf before Notebook and save the toolbar.

title: Make a custom reading theme
description: Increase Scripture text size and give a custom theme a warmer page color.
steps: Increase text size in Settings.
Create and name a theme.
Edit the page color and see the reader change.

title: Choose how cards appear
description: Save reference-hover behavior and inspect Notebook preferences.
steps: Open Hover and cards in Settings.
Choose reference-only hover cards.
Open Notebook preferences.

title: Keep a frequently used action
description: Save a named action with the current-chapter placeholder and a keyboard shortcut.
steps: Create a toolbar command.
Name it and enter compare {chapter} ylt.
Review the filled preview, assign a shortcut, and keep it.

title: Start reading at your own pace
description: Choose John, start an undated plan, open its reading, and mark the first day read.
steps: Name a plan and choose John.
Choose My own pace, no dates.
Start, open the reading, and mark it read.

title: Arrange reading days by hand
description: Move a chapter between days and retain the manually arranged schedule.
steps: Create a three-day reference plan.
Open the day builder.
Drag a chapter between days and start the arranged plan.

title: Import your own reading list
description: Enter a short sample list and review detected readings before starting.
steps: Open the plan importer.
Enter one reference per day and identify the source.
Review the detected schedule and start it.

title: Resume after missed reading days
description: Review missed-day choices, shift unfinished readings, and rename the plan.
steps: Open an existing sample plan with missed days.
Review the consequences and choose to pick up where you left off.
Rename the plan.

title: Return to a past plan
description: Stop a sample plan while preserving its reading log, then use it again.
steps: Stop an active sample plan.
Inspect Past plans and its recorded progress.
Use the plan again with a new start date.
